basketball_reference_examples.note_text: Traded a 2025 2nd round draft pick (Ryan Kalkbrenner was later selected), a 2028 2nd round draft pick and a 2029 2nd round draft pick to the Phoenix Suns for Isaiah Todd, a 2024 1st round draft pick and a 2030 1st round draft pick. 2024 1st-rd pick was a right to swap, did not convey. 2030 1st-rd pick is a right to swap. 2028 2nd-rd pick is MEM own. 2029 2nd-rd pick is MEM own. 2025 2nd-rd pick is NOP own.

As part of a 3-team trade, the Memphis Grizzlies traded David Roddy to the Phoenix Suns; the Memphis Grizzlies traded Vanja Marinkovic to the Brooklyn Nets; the Brooklyn Nets traded Royce O'Neale to the Phoenix Suns; the Phoenix Suns traded Keita Bates-Diop, Jordan Goodwin, a 2026 2nd round draft pick, a 2028 2nd round draft pick and a 2029 2nd round draft pick to the Brooklyn Nets; and the Phoenix Suns traded Chimezie Metu, Yuta Watanabe and a 2026 1st round draft pick to the Memphis Grizzlies. Memphis also received a trade exception. 2026 1st-rd pick is a right to swap. 2026 2nd-rd pick is least favorable. 2028 2nd-rd pick is MEM own. 2029 2nd-rd pick is MEM own.
Converted Vince Williams Jr. from a two-way contract to a regular contract. Waived Bismack Biyombo.
